newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Southwest monsoon in full swing over Sri Lanka.
newsitem.headline: Southwest monsoon in full swing over Sri Lanka.

text.p: The southwest monsoon became active over Sri Lanka on Wednesday, the deputy director of the Meteorology Department, P.M Jayatilaka Banda, said on Thursday.

"Under the influence of the monsoon the southwest region and the hydro catchment areas are getting rains," he said. "These active conditions will last for another two days and largely help the power situation," he told Reuters.
Rain in hydro catchment areas are important as Sri Lanka largely relies on hydro power to meet its electricity needs.
Failure of monsoon rains last year saw the water levels in catchment areas dropping sharply and forced the government to impose daily eight-hour power cuts.
The monsoon should last until the end of September.
